result.reason: The redline implements a three-month cap on the Company's termination payment and retains a compliant 90-day Customer notice period, but it does not complete the fallback because Vendor remains able to terminate on 90 days' notice during a committed term. It also omits the preferred 30-day notice period and pro-rata refund. The drafting retains awkward and potentially ambiguous language, including the renewal/termination structure and the cap's reference to Section 3.1 “payments” rather than expressly defined fees.
